tw: This discussion on a cushion turns into a fuss, so Kron says, 'Hush!'
twc: 这场坐在靠垫上的讨论吵成一团，Kron 喊了声“嘘！”

tw: Kron asks a cat to check every aspect of his black jacket.
twc: Kron 请一只猫检查他黑夹克的每一个方面。

tw: Kron gives an inspiring talk, and a spy throws a pie into the sky.
twc: Kron 做了场鼓舞人心的演讲，一个间谍激动得把派抛上了天。

tw: Kron's dad drags him on, but Kron turns to admire a choir of tires.
twc: 爸爸拖着 Kron 往前走，他却回头去欣赏一支轮胎合唱团。

tw: His historian friend tells Kron a story so boring he snores on the floor.
twc: 他的历史学家朋友讲的故事太无聊，Kron 躺在地上打呼噜。

tw: Kron the chemist mixes ten lemons, and a hen is lost in the mist.
twc: 化学家 Kron 混了十个柠檬，一只母鸡消失在雾里。

tw: Kron the physicist walks off cool while his fizzy test fizzes up behind him.
twc: 物理学家 Kron 酷酷走开，身后的汽水实验喷上了天。

tw: Kron's hunger runs him to a hundred buns under the hot sun.
twc: Kron 饿极了，顶着大太阳冲向一百个面包。

tw: In Chemistry class, Kron's red jelly shakes, and Ken's desk melts.
twc: 化学课上，Kron 的红果冻一抖，Ken 的课桌就化了。

tw: Kron won't drop out of school; he hops to the top and shouts.
twc: Kron 才不辍学，他跳到最高处大声喊。

tw: Kron's camel pal eats the calendar, and Kron has no days left.
twc: Kron 的骆驼朋友把日历吃了，Kron 一天都不剩了。

tw: Kron's big discovery: under the cover, a dove lives in his lovely glove.
twc: Kron 的大发现：被子底下，一只鸽子住在他心爱的手套里。

tw: Nurse Kron feeds the wounded balloon soup with a spoon at noon.
twc: 护士 Kron 中午用勺子给受伤的气球喂汤。

tw: Kron sits with a British gran, knitting a little fish to fit his dish.
twc: Kron 和一位英国奶奶坐着，织一条刚好放进盘子的小鱼。

tw: Kron's chair at the airport is a bear with short hair.
twc: Kron 在机场的座椅是一头短毛熊。

tw: Kron's tiny nation has eight stations and one train on a tray.
twc: Kron 的小国家有八个车站和托盘上的一列火车。

tw: Kron's yawn will spread from Fred to Ted, and they all go to bed.
twc: Kron 的哈欠会从 Fred 传到 Ted，大家都上床睡觉了。

tw: Kron's tree has a sneezy disease, so it sneezes peas on the bees.
twc: Kron 的树得了打喷嚏的病，把豌豆喷到了蜜蜂身上。

tw: Kron the pioneer rides a deer and plants a pie flag on the pier.
twc: 先驱 Kron 骑着鹿，在码头上插下一面派做的旗。

tw: Kron's admirable rabbit can stack an apple on a table on a cab.
twc: Kron 那只令人钦佩的兔子能把苹果叠在出租车上的桌子上。
